overall: Atlanta is experiencing a partially cloudy late-morning warm-up, with the current temp at 80.6°F as of 12:30 ET and still rising at +2.5°F/hr. forecast_obs_notes: The NWP models are reasonably clustered — HRRR at 83.9°F, ECMWF at 85.5°F, and NBM at 86.2°F — with the NWS official forecast slightly more bullish at 88°F, likely reflecting an optimistic clearing scenario.
